headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: August 10, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with Abimelec Ortiz leading the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run. The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing the game 4-3, with Eli White leading the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats. The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a convincing 11-1 victory, with Sean Manaea leading the way for the Mets.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, including Griffin Jax, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026. Additionally, Cooper Pratt has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a right hamstring strain, while Jack Leiter has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a right ankle posterior impingement.

The Kansas City Royals have bolstered their lineup with the acquisition of 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins, while the Athletics have traded for RHP Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies in exchange for RF Colby Thomas.

top_news.title: **Reds Fall to Nationals in One-Sided Affair**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds suffered a 7-1 loss to the Washington Nationals, with the Nationals dominating the game from start to finish. Abimelec Ortiz led the Reds' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, while Brad Lord pitched 2.2 strong innings for the Reds.

top_news.title: **Athletics Edge Red Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Oakland Athletics secured a narrow win over the Boston Red Sox, finishing the game 4-3. Eli White led the Athletics' offense with 3 hits in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Mets Cruise Past Pirates 11-1**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets dominated the Pittsburgh Pirates, securing a convincing 11-1 victory. Sean Manaea led the way for the Mets, pitching 7.0 innings with 11 strikeouts and just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Blue Jays in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a 7-6 victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, with Kyle Schwarber leading the charge at the plate. Schwarber hit two home runs and drove in four runs, while Jesús Luzardo pitched 7.0 innings with 12 strikeouts for the Blue Jays.

top_news.title: **Rays RHP Griffin Jax Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Tampa Bay Rays right-hander Griffin Jax has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to August 6, 2026.

top_news.title: **Royals Acquire Jacob Berry in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals have made a move to bolster their lineup, acquiring 1B Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. Berry joins the Royals after being traded in a deal that brings new depth to the team's first base position.
